lines.text: Charlie the kitten jumped onto the dining table and yowled, Gimme a bowl of warm milk!
He tapped his paws impatiently, but Mama Cat kept quietly reading her morning paper!
I said give it to me right now! hissed Charlie, puffing up his gray tail!
Mama looked over her glasses and asked, What happened to your golden manners key?
Barking orders makes people feel bossed around and closes their willingness to help!
Charlie sat down neatly, tucked his tail around his paws, and said softly, Please, Mama?
Mama beamed, poured a creamy dish of milk with cinnamon, and stroked his furry ears!
The word Please is a magical golden key that opens hearts with kindness and respect!
